info.description: An application captured from /work-with-us's "Apply Now" modal (Figma node 924:23856) — exactly the fields drawn there (Full Name, Email Address, Phone Number, Experience (in Years), Current Location, Resume/CV, Additional Message) plus a plain string field recording which job's title the applicant applied for (node 924:23508's "Apply Now" always opens this same form for whichever job card it was launched from — there's no relation target since job listings live as a repeatable component on api::work-with-us-page, not a standalone collection type). Disclosed exception: Figma draws the Experience field as a dropdown (chevron) but shows it closed with no option list anywhere in the file — user-approved fallback is standard year-range buckets (fresher/1-3/3-5/5-10/10+ years); enum values use identifier-safe keys (Strapi rejects enum members starting with a digit) with human labels rendered client-side. Public API grants `create` only — no public find/findOne/update/delete — so a visitor can submit an application but never read, list, or tamper with anyone else's.
